mapper.select: select * from problemSet order by problemId desc
mapper.insert: insert into problemSet(problemName, problemDescription, problemInputDescription, problemOutputDescription, problemInput, problemOutput, memoryLimit, timeLimit) values (#{problemName}, #{problemDescription}, #{problemInputDescription}, #{problemOutputDescription}, #{problemInput}, #{problemOutput}, #{memoryLimit}, #{timeLimit})
mapper.update:
update problemSet
problemName = #{problemName},
problemDescription = #{problemDescription},
problemInputDescription = #{problemInputDescription},
problemOutputDescription = #{problemOutputDescription},
problemInput = #{problemInput},
problemOutput = #{problemOutput},
memoryLimit = #{memoryLimit},
timeLimit = #{timeLimit},
where problemId = #{problemId}
